title: Counting Sort Frequency Loop
statement: The frequency-counting step of counting sort is the loop over all $n$ input items that computes the item's key-cell address as the count-array base plus the key plus one, then increments the value stored in that cell by one.
caveat: The statement depends on omitted definitions for the loop, variables, and arithmetic notation, so the exact bounds and memory-address interpretation cannot be fully recovered.
